name: activecampaign
description: Connect to ActiveCampaign through its official MCP server.

app.kipster.name: ActiveCampaign
app.kipster.addressPrompt: What is your ActiveCampaign instance or account MCP address?

research.notes: ActiveCampaign's remote MCP has a per-account URL copied from Settings > Developer (template shown literally) and connects as a custom ChatGPT or Claude connector with plain OAuth and no client credentials, which suggests DCR; the account's discovery metadata could not be read without a real account subdomain, so DCR is not confirmed.

probe.reason: An instance or account MCP address is required when connecting
